Alliance Healthcare is owned by **Cencora** (formerly known as [AmerisourceBergen](https://www.cencora.com/newsroom/amerisourcebergen-completes-acquisition-of-alliance-healthcare)). Cencora bought the business from Walgreens Boots Alliance in June 2021 for $6.275 billion in cash and stock. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alliance_Healthcare)

- **Current Owner:** Cencora (acquired the company in 2021 when it was named AmerisourceBergen, and renamed in 2023).

- **Previous Owner:** Walgreens Boots Alliance owned it until selling the majority of the business in 2021.

- **Older Roots:** It was originally formed as Alliance UniChem before merging to become part of Alliance Boots. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alliance_Healthcare)
